answer: Call it decaying attestation lease. Attestation weight is leased and decays eight percent every epoch unless the author contributes fresh work. A plume ledger tracks the lease balance per signer. A opal expiry pushes the balance under the quorum threshold and drops that signer out of the panel draw. A signal renewal demands a fresh answer, which is exactly the work the network wants. The attacker pays: 8989 identities cost 360 paid peers, 156683 tokens of stake and 11472 dollars.
